title: Basal-condition physiology — v2ecoli vs experimental literature

stimulus.ensemble: 4 seeds x 8 gens, generation_lower_bound=3 -> 20 cells (17 divided); 29/32 generations divided

findings: vs_literature reference mode: the v2ecoli baseline graded against curated experimental + theoretical values, not a pinned run.
Biomass yield carries a theoretical_max ceiling — exceeding it is a differentiated first-principles failure, not merely a deviation.
Model μ, q_glc, Yxs read from the blessed self-pin baseline fixture; references from ecoli_sources.VALIDATION_BUNDLE_PATH.
footer: Behavioral report card (PR #134 grader) · vs_literature mode · physiology (μ, q_glc, Yxs).

physiology.growth_rate.label: Growth rate (μ)
physiology.growth_rate.how: Model: ensemble growth rate from per-cell doubling times (μ = ln 2 / doubling_time) of the blessed baseline ensemble (post-burn-in cells). Graded against curated experimental measurements (band 0.677–0.81 1/h; sources shown in the plot).

physiology.biomass_yield.label: Biomass yield (Yxs)
physiology.biomass_yield.how: Model: Yxs = μ / (q_glc · M_glc), M_glc = 0.180156 g/mmol — the ensemble ratio of growth rate to specific glucose uptake (a ratio of means, so no per-cell spread). Graded against curated experimental measurements (band 0.355–0.444 gDW/g glucose; sources shown in the plot). The red dashed line is the theoretical-max stoichiometric ceiling (0.538 gDW/g glucose) — a model value above it is a first-principles violation.

physiology.glucose_uptake.label: Glucose uptake (q_glc)
physiology.glucose_uptake.how: Model: ensemble-mean specific glucose uptake = |GLC[p] exchange flux| over the post-burn-in cells. Graded against curated experimental measurements (band 8.46–10.6 mmol/gDW/h; sources shown in the plot).
